presentation.label: Live-record quantize on [REC] + [PLAY]
presentation.summary: Hold [REC] and tap [PLAY] to see QUANTIZE LIVE REC in a toast; tap [PLAY] again while it is up to switch it.
presentation.overview: QUANTIZE LIVE REC decides whether live-recorded trigs snap to the steps. Stock keeps it in PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE. This module shows it on the gesture that starts live recording and lets a second tap switch it, without leaving the page you are on.
highlights: OS 1.40C only. The author tested the gesture and a power cycle on an MKI. On an MKII, in combined test builds with other modules (13 October 2026), the user reported the gesture working, both toasts fitting the screen and a changed setting surviving a power cycle.
The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording, as on stock. While live recording runs, further [REC] + [PLAY] presses do nothing on stock; here they show or invert the setting.
If a stock notification happens to be on screen while [REC] is held, the first [PLAY] inverts the setting instead of only showing it; the toast then shows the new value.
The setting is the stock global PERSONALIZE value in battery-backed memory: not saved per project or Part, and reset by an OS upgrade like the rest of PERSONALIZE.
usage: Hold [REC] and tap [PLAY]: a toast shows LIVE REC: QUANTIZED or LIVE REC: UNQUANTIZED, the current setting, and live recording starts as on the stock OS.
While the toast is still on screen (about one second), keep [REC] held and tap [PLAY] again to invert the setting; the toast reopens with the new value.
Tap [PLAY] once more while it is up to switch back, or release [REC] to close the toast; the setting stays as last shown.
Press [STOP] to end live recording. PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE > QUANTIZE LIVE REC shows and edits the same setting.

controls.name: QUANTIZE LIVE REC
controls.doc: The stock PERSONALIZE setting. QUANTIZED is the ticked QUANTIZE LIVE REC box. The module does not change its stored value or default; it only adds the [REC] + [PLAY] gesture that shows and inverts it.

limitations: OS 1.40C only. The author tested the gesture and a power cycle on an MKI. On an MKII, in combined test builds with other modules (13 October 2026), the user reported the gesture working, both toasts fitting the screen and a changed setting surviving a power cycle.
The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording, as on stock. While live recording runs, further [REC] + [PLAY] presses do nothing on stock; here they show or invert the setting.
If a stock notification happens to be on screen while [REC] is held, the first [PLAY] inverts the setting instead of only showing it; the toast then shows the new value.
The setting is the stock global PERSONALIZE value in battery-backed memory: not saved per project or Part, and reset by an OS upgrade like the rest of PERSONALIZE.
The PERSONALIZE row does not redraw while it is open, and the author noted an occasional small empty box where the toast was right after it closes.
This is the all-or-nothing QUANTIZE LIVE REC setting, not the per-track TRIG QUANT. No effect slot, menu row or project data is added.
Card builds only: the Modwerk base cannot load it over USB until its loader carries ColdFire modules with stock-code hooks.

resources.recorded: 12 October 2026; source assembly and the image gate under the ColdFire port

storage.label: ROM code and detours
storage.conditions: One position-independent linked unit of 180 bytes (code and two strings) in free ROM space, and two six-byte jmp detours over stock instructions. No RAM, no DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, per key press
processing.display: at most 24 authored instructions per press
processing.conditions: Longest path through the [PLAY] entry (invert, then reopen the toast), counted from the source; stock routines it calls are excluded. Runs only on a [PLAY] press or [REC] release, never per frame.

impact.conditions: A key-press handler: nothing runs between presses.

cpu.rationale: Two to about two dozen instructions on a [PLAY] press or [REC] release; no per-frame or per-sample work.

dsp.rationale: No DSP code and no change to the DSP programs.

memory.rationale: 192 bytes of ROM; no RAM or audio memory of its own.

tests.summary: The image gate passes 29 checks: the retired 0x400522ca site left as the original OS has it, both jmp detours and the unit's 180 bytes in place, then under the ColdFire port by the keys (MKII panel) the show, invert, invert-back, expiry and [REC]-release behaviour beside the original OS under the same keys, and a power cycle of the port keeping an inverted setting. The toast wording is Modwerk’s; the author reported the gesture and a power cycle on an MKI (25 and 30 September 2026) for his own build. On an MKII, in combined test builds with other modules (13 October 2026), the user reported the gesture working, both toasts fitting the screen and a changed setting surviving a power cycle.
